label: Bible Study
prompt: All we like _____ have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verse: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
note: The suffering servant chapter — we wander like sheep; he carries the iniquity.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: It is of the LORD'S _____ that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verse: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
note: A verse about not being consumed, written in a book called Lamentations — hope in the ashes.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the _____. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;
verse: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;
note: Nathan's four-word thunderclap to King David — the shortest sermon that ever landed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Cast thy _____ upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
verse: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.
note: The Preacher's case for generous risk: release it now, and it comes back with interest — eventually.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And as he reasoned of righteousness, _____, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
verse: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
note: Paul preached self-control — 'temperance' — to a governor who had none, and Felix trembled.
